text: Tap the egg after you tap the book.
Turn the dial up by four.
Tap the crown, but only if it is yellow.
Before you tap the chest, tap the crown.
Zip wants to fly all the way to the moon. What should he ride in?
Tap the heart. Then tap the flag.
Tap the potion, then the star, then the rocket.
Do not give the robot long arms or short arms. Give it an orange body and a green nose.
Tap the potion, then the book, then the egg. After that, tap the gem, then the drum.
First, tap the knight. Next, the ring. Then, the key. Last, the torch.
If you see a dragon, tap the egg. If not, tap the shield.
Zip packed a star for the trip. Puff packed a map. Then they walked to the castle together. What did Zip pack?

It rained all night, and the path was full of puddles. Zip the robot did not want rusty feet. So he pulled something tall and rubbery onto each foot and splashed all the way to school. What did Zip put on?
After you tap the drum, tap the hat.
Tap the one to the right of the bell.
Captain says, tap the blue sword.
Count the mushrooms. Tap the hat that many times.
The orange ring goes under the table. The purple bell goes on the table.
Put everything that is neither red nor purple in the chest.
First go left two squares. Then go up two squares.
Tap the yellow sword, then the red crown, then the yellow heart.
Go right two, up two, left three, then down two.
Pounce the cat picked up a flag. Then she picked up a gem. Last, she picked up a ring. Tap them in the same order.
Tap the mushroom that is not next to a key.
Dash the fox had a yellow hat and an orange rocket. She gave the hat to a friend. What does Dash have now?
Paint the one between the coin and the book blue, the coin orange, and the second one from the right yellow.
Before you give the robot claws, give it a pointy head. Then give it a red body, three eyes and one button.
Tap the big green drum, then the small yellow flag, then the small green flag, then the big yellow drum.
Paint all the big things green.
There are four big things.
Tap the purple shield.
This robot has four eyes and two antennas. Give it a square head and an orange body.
First, tap the orange torch. Then, the blue rocket. Last, the green star.
Tap the chest three times.
Give the robot three antennas after you give it legs. It also needs four buttons, a round head and a red body.
Go to the tower, then to the tent.
Tap the owl two times, the heart two times, and the mushroom once.
If there are more purple things than orange things, tap the map. If not, tap the egg.
Tap the mushroom before you tap the shield.
Tap the drum, then the boot, then the gem, then the knight, then the dragon.
Give the robot a jet after you give it four buttons. It also needs two eyes, a yellow nose and claws.
Zip the robot picked up a bell. Then he picked up a ring. Last, he picked up a potion. What did Zip pick up last?
Press the orange button, then flip the green switch.
If the flag is yellow, tap it.
Set the dial to eight, then flip both switches. Then press launch, unless the light is red.
Tap the sword first. Then tap the hat.
Paint all the rockets red.
Put three potions and one egg in the chest.
Go down two, then left one.
Some of the flags are small.
Tap the chest.
It is very dark inside the cave. What should Zip take to help him see?
Tap the crown, then the heart, then the map, then the ring.
After you tap the key, tap the boot.
Tap the hat before you tap the sword.
Tap the green potion.
Boo the ghost picked up a chest. Then he picked up a flag. Last, he picked up a shield. What did Boo pick up first?
Flip every switch that is down, then press the blue button.
Tap the chest next to the orange egg.
Tap the ghost.
Press the red button.
Count the books. Tap the ring that many times.
Tap the key, the chest, the fox, the dragon, and the sword, but leave out the third one.
The code is eight, six, two, zero, one, nine.
Tap the fifth one from the right.
If there are more rings than eggs, tap the mushroom. If not, tap the shield.
Before you tap the sword, tap the torch.
Tap the potion three times, the torch three times, and the fox two times.
Flip the blue switch, then set the dial to two.
Give the robot an orange body and a yellow nose.
Flip every switch except the green one, then press launch.
Tap the purple egg, then the red coin.
This robot has long arms, a jet and a pointy head.
Boo the ghost had an orange star and a yellow shield. He gave the star to a friend. What does Boo have now?
Before you go to the cave, visit the rock.
Take the purple crown, the potion and three shields. If there is a gem on the shelf, put them in the cart. If not, put them in the chest.
Captain says, tap the yellow shield.
The flag is bigger than the crown.

Pounce the cat spent the morning at the village market. First, she looked at a map. Next, she bought a mushroom. After that, she rang a bell. Finally, she waved a flag. What was the third thing Pounce did?
Tap the rocket on the right.
Tap the blue crown, then the yellow flag.
Put the blue potion and the orange drum in the basket and the crown in the bag, but only if there is a boot on the shelf.
Paint all the small things yellow, unless they are boots. Paint the big boot orange.
Tap the heart. The blue one.
Give the robot three eyes, a jet and short arms. It has fewer buttons than eyes.
If the star is blue, tap it.
This robot has one antenna and twice as many buttons as antennas. Give it a red nose, wheels and a square head.
Tap the green potion, the yellow map, and then the red wizard.
Go to the house, then to the tower. Touch neither the pond nor the tent.
Tap the key after the rocket.
Paint the big egg orange and the small flag blue.
Drive one square to the right.
Drive the rover to the tree.
If you see a robot, tap the star. If not, tap the coin.
None of the boots are small.
First, tap the blue torch. Then, the red fox. Last, the green shield.
Tap the green gem.
Paint the mushroom and the boot orange.
First, flip the blue switch. Next, press the blue button three times. Last, press launch.
Tap the yellow flag.
Tap the one between the mushroom and the flag.
Press the green button one time for each switch that is down.
Tap the coin before the shield.
Turn the dial up by one.
Move the rover left three squares.
Paint every small thing green, but not the heart. Paint the heart purple.
Press the purple button three times, then flip the purple switch.
Give the robot the smaller wheels, the longest arms, one button, three antennas and a purple nose.

Zazz the wizard was so small that he could not reach his own door handle. So he mixed something fizzy in a bottle and drank it all in one gulp. In a blink, he was as tall as a tree. What did Zazz drink?
Tap the orange map.
Paint the hat green and the chest orange.
Pack the bag with the orange coin, the rocket and two swords.
Tap everything that is small but not red.
Tap the red potion, then the red boot.
Move the rover up one square.
First drive to the blue flag. Then drive to the house.
Tap the heart. No, wait! Tap the crown instead.

Zip the robot set off for the mountain with an egg, a book, a potion, and a torch. On the way, the potion fell in the mud, but he wiped it clean. Later, the egg sank to the bottom of the river, and it was gone for good. In the end, Zip had to turn back. Why did Zip have to turn back?

Pounce the cat could not sleep. So a friend sat beside her, opened something with lots of pages, and read out loud about a brave little mouse. Before the end, Pounce was snoring. What did the friend open?
Tap the small blue drum.
Tap the yellow boot, then the orange egg.
Tap the big potion.
Put one map under the table and two in the pot.
First go right two squares. Then go up one square.
Tap the heart next to the orange key.
Press the orange button, then set the dial to four.
Flip the red switch, then press the blue button, then press the red button.
Zazz the wizard is carrying a rocket to the castle. What is Zazz carrying?
The blue heart is in the middle of the row.
Tap the red one that is not a map.
Put all but one of the stars in the chest.
Press the purple button three times, then set the dial to four. Then press launch, unless the light is red.
Tap the purple coin, the red rocket, and then the blue egg.

Zip the robot was on his way to the puppet show. He looked at an egg for just one second. Then he sat down to look at a key for a long, long time. After that, he walked right past a heart without stopping. When he got there at last, everyone had gone home. Why was Zip so late?
Tap the torch, then the mushroom, then the dragon, then the heart.
Everything is green except the mushroom.
Paint the big coin and the small egg purple.
Tap all the crowns except the purple one.
Tap all the orange things except the chest.
Tap the big coin.
Tap the crown, then the shield, then the egg, then the potion.
Put all the swords in the chest except the orange one.
Press the purple button, then flip the purple switch.
This robot has an orange nose and a blue body.
Paint the last one orange, the one in the middle blue, and the first two purple.
Paint all the books yellow except the small one. Paint that one red and the map purple.
Tap the boot that is not next to a potion.
Tap the gem. No, wait! Tap the ring instead.
If there are more stars than shields, tap the crown and then the bell. If not, tap the bell and then the crown.
Tap the big sword.
Tap the orange heart, then the green bell.
Tap all the flags except the red one.
Tap the star in the top row.
First, tap the hat. Then, tap the drum. Last, tap the flag.
This robot has no antennas and two buttons. Give it short arms and a red nose.
First, tap the potion. Then, tap the flag.
Tap the orange rocket, then the red ring, then the green knight.
The bell goes in the pot.
Tap the map before the star.
Tap the map, the rocket, the torch, the ghost, and the coin, but leave out the first one.
Tap the small ring.
Paint the third one from the left purple, the fourth one from the right yellow, and the first one orange.
First, tap the crown. Then, tap the flag.
The door to the tower is locked. What does the knight need to open it?
Give the robot the shortest arms, one button, the smaller wheels and three antennas.
There are more blue things than yellow things.
Do not put two crowns in the pot until you have put the purple shield in the cart.
The second thing from the right is a star.
If the flag is blue and the potion is green, tap the flag and then the potion. If not, tap the potion and then the flag.
Build a robot with a jet and a pointy head, not a round one. Give it claws, not short arms.
Put everything yellow in the basket.
Tap the map, but only if you see both a knight and a cat.
Tap the green gem.
Before you go to the bridge, visit the rock. But before the rock, go to the tower.
Before you go to the pond, visit the tower. But before the tower, go to the bridge.

Zip the robot spent the morning at the village market. First, he waved a flag. Then he sniffed a potion. After that, he tried on a ring. Last of all, he rang a bell. What was the second thing Zip did?
Tap the third map from the right.
First, tap the hat. Then, tap the egg. Last, tap the torch.
The heart is small.
Tap the boot before you tap the torch.
Tap the chest, then the heart, then the bell.
Tap the big blue chest.
Captain says, tap the red flag.
Tap the hat.

Pounce the cat had a birthday party. Hoot the owl gave her a shield, and she jumped for joy. Dash the fox gave her a coin, and she put it away in a drawer. Puff the dragon gave her a sword, and she said a quiet thank you. What made Pounce so happy?
None of the shields are small.
Tap the ring, then tap the egg.
Hoot the owl is carrying a potion to the castle. What is Hoot carrying?
Tap the orange star.
Tap the key first. Then tap the shield.
This robot has claws, legs and a round head.
First, press the red button. Next, set the dial to eight. Last, press the green button.
Tap the green crown.
There are three orange books.
Zazz the wizard picked up a torch. Then he picked up a book. Last, he picked up a ring. What did Zazz pick up last?
The code is seven, one, four, five, three.
If you see a wizard, tap the potion.
Build a robot with a green nose, wheels and long arms.
If there is a book, tap the crown. If not, tap the bell.
The parrot says, tap the green key.
Tap the torch.
Flip the blue switch, then press the orange button.
Put all the maps in the chest, unless there is a bell on the shelf.
Tap the yellow map, then the purple shield, then the green gem.
Tap the coin that is not orange.

Zazz the wizard packed a bag for a long boat ride. He put in a torch and a shield. He wanted a crown and a hat too, but there was no more room. At the last minute, he squeezed in a drum and a book. Tap everything Zazz packed.
Tap the one to the left of the star.
Tap the small coin.
Tap the potion two times.
Tap the shield.
This robot has three antennas and one more button than antennas. Give it short arms, an orange nose and a jet.
There are fewer potions than swords.
Go up one square.
Tap the red gem, then the purple chest, then the blue map.
Tap all the purple keys.

There was a big party at the castle last night. Dash the fox came early and helped with the food. Boo the ghost got lost and never got there. Hoot the owl brought a huge cake. Puff the dragon danced all night long. Pounce the cat arrived late and stayed to the end. Tap everyone who was at the party.
Put the big rocket in the pot and the small rocket in the cart.
Paint the one in the middle green, the first two red, and the last one yellow.
If you see a fox, tap the map and then the chest. If you do not, tap the drum and then the heart.
Tap the map that is between the two rings.
If there are more maps than shields, put two maps under the table. If not, put two shields in the chest.
After you tap the crown, tap the map.
This robot has a green nose and a red body.
Tap the big purple crown.
Build a robot with wheels, four eyes, two antennas and a pointy head.
Tap the shield three times, the book once, and the flag three times.
Tap the shield, then the ghost, then the hat. After that, tap the torch, then the boot.
Type this code backwards: two, eight, six.
Give the robot a yellow body, one eye and short arms. It has the same number of buttons as eyes.
Tap the yellow flag.
First, tap the mushroom. Next, the egg. Then, the boot. Last, the flag.
Tap the fox, then the mushroom, then the knight, then the flag, then the rocket.
Give the robot a red nose after you give it two antennas. It also needs legs, a square head and four eyes.
Tap the cat.
Build a robot with a green body, legs and claws.
Tap the second blue one from the left.
Give the robot two eyes, a purple body and a jet. It has the same number of antennas as eyes.
Tap the third map from the left.
Pounce the cat found an orange gem under the bridge. Boo the ghost found a red key. Then they swapped, just for fun. What does Pounce have now?
Tap the things that are neither purple nor small.
Paint all the coins red. Paint the flag orange, but only if it is big.
After you tap the potion, tap the gem.
Tap the boot.
Either the map or the shield is yellow.
Both the coin and the bell are big.
Tap the boot that is not purple.
There are three hearts, and all of them are blue.
Put the red hat on the table after you put the sword and the torch in the chest.
Tap the wizard.
Find the blue ring and tap it.
The code is six, zero, five, eight, seven, one.
Build a robot with a pointy head and a green body, not an orange one. Give it claws, not long arms.
Drive the rover to the house.
Tap the bell first. Then tap the mushroom.
Tap the blue chest.
If there are more flags than shields, paint the flags yellow. If not, paint the shields red.
Give the robot short arms, wheels and a red nose.
Tap the big yellow hat.
Paint all the gems yellow except the small one. Paint that one orange and the bell blue.
First, tap the purple fox. Then, the green heart. Last, the yellow bell.
Paint everything that is neither a boot nor a gem blue. Paint the boots green.
Tap the star, but only if it is orange.
First put the blue shield in the chest, then the hat under the table, and last the bell in the chest.
There are two purple things.
Tap the red drum, then the yellow mushroom, then the green chest.
Pounce found something growing under a tree in the damp forest. What was it?
Tap the one to the left of the egg.
Tap the cat, then the coin, then the fox, then the flag, then the robot.
Before you tap the coin, tap the gem.
Go to the red flag.
Zip the robot put a star under the map and an egg behind the drum. Later, he moved the star under the bell. Then he moved the egg to the place where the star was at the start. Where is the star now?
Paint all the bells orange.
Tap the dragon, the owl, the bell, the torch, the shield, and then the fox.
Paint all the big things orange, unless they are books. Paint the small book blue.
Pick the last body and the second head. This robot has two buttons and one more antenna than buttons.
Put the ring in the bag.
The owl gave a gem to the wizard. Who got the gem?
Go to the yellow flag. On the way, pick up only the key.

Zazz the wizard put on a magic show for the whole village. First, he made a potion bubble. Next, he made an egg float. After that, he pulled a rabbit out of a hat. Finally, he made a ring spin in the air. What did Zazz do right after he pulled a rabbit out of the hat?
After you tap the egg, tap the crown.
If the map is purple, tap it.
Tap everything that can fly.
There are three small things.
Tap the star.
The band is ready to march. What do you hit with sticks to keep the beat?
Set the dial to eight and press the green button.
Tap all the orange things except the key.
Paint the gem and the shield purple.
Build a robot with short arms, two buttons, four eyes and one antenna.
Tap the small ring, unless it is blue.
Flip the orange switch, then press the orange button.
If there are more red things than blue things, tap the star. If not, tap the flag.
Press the green button three times.
Tap the chest. Oh, and tap the bell too.
Paint all the swords yellow and all the hats purple.
Give the robot legs, a square head and two eyes. It has more antennas than eyes.

Hoot the owl hid a gem behind the drum. A crow was watching, so she moved it behind the shield. She thought about putting it inside the rocket, but she did not. In the end, she left it right where it was. Where is the gem now?
Build a robot with wheels and short arms.
Tap the map. The small one.
If you see a dragon, tap the sword and then the ring. If you do not, tap the torch and then the book.
The old king was sad, because nobody at the market knew who he was. So he went home and came back with something golden and shiny on his head. Now everybody bowed. What did the king put on?
Puff wants to learn a new magic spell. What should he read?
Put all but one of the stars in the bag.
Tap the red boot.
Tap the map, the fox, the ring, and the boot, but skip the fox.
There is an orange coin.
Tap the potion, then the mushroom, then the chest.
Tap the yellow fox, then the green chest, then the purple coin.
Tap the book, then the key, then the mushroom, then the flag.
A little bird is singing outside. Now, tap the green coin.
Go down two, left two, up two, then left one.
Tap the heart, then tap the gem.
If you see a cat, tap the egg.
First, tap the green wizard. Then, the red boot. Last, the blue dragon.
The yellow star is between the green star and the shield.
The chest is at the right end of the row.
Build a robot with a jet and claws.
Put everything yellow in the cart and everything purple in the basket.
Press the yellow button, flip the green switch, then set the dial to four. If the light is green, press launch. If it is red, flip the yellow switch instead.
Paint the big shield blue, the small shield green, and the crown purple.
If the robot has a square head, it gets three antennas. If it has a pointy head, it gets two antennas. Give it a red body, a pointy head and claws.
Captain says, tap the green torch.
Tap the green gem, then the purple hat, then the green chest.
If a thing is small, paint it green. Paint the big ones purple.
Put two rings and the mushroom in the chest.
Boo the ghost found an orange hat in the cave. What did Boo find?
Tap the crown, then the ghost, then the ring. After that, tap the potion, then the book.
Put everything that is neither green nor purple in the bag.
The camp fire is warm and cozy. Now, tap the purple torch.
Tap the ring on the right.
Tap the potion, then the heart, then the mushroom.
First, tap the shield. Next, the map. Then, the egg. Last, the key.
Tap the things you can wear that are yellow.
Press the yellow button three times, then flip the green switch.
Tap the heart next to the coin.
Sir Clank the knight hid the coin under the hat. Where is the coin?
Paint both things next to the sword green, the sword purple, and the first one blue.
Tap the small red chest.
Go to the tower, then to the rock, then to the cave.
There are three books, and all of them are orange.
None of the bells are yellow, but three of the potions are.
Tap the yellow potion, then the orange egg, then the yellow mushroom.
Tap the yellow crown.
Tap the heart, then the rocket, then the shield, then the book.
The gem should be yellow, and the flag should be purple.
Flip the purple switch.
Tap the drum after the rocket.
If you see a knight, tap the ring.
Tap the drum, then the cat, then the book, then the heart.
Tap the big purple potion.
Press every button except the yellow one, then press launch.
First, tap the orange fox. Then, the blue owl. Last, the green boot.
Paint the big book green, the small book orange, the potion blue, and the hat purple.
Tap the chest that is between the two eggs.
Go to the rock. Pick up the red key on the way, but not the green one.
Sir Clank the knight found a red map on the beach. What did Sir Clank find?
Before you put the shield on the table, put two rockets under the table.

Zip the robot was on his way to the royal feast. He walked right past a ring without stopping. Then he hopped over a bell and kept going. After that, he stopped to play with a coin for a whole hour. When he got there at last, everyone had gone home. Why was Zip so late?
Put two yellow swords in the bag.
If there is a gem, tap the crown. If not, tap the flag.
After you tap the egg, tap the mushroom.
Before you tap the drum, tap the chest.
Tap the wizard, the crown, the rocket, and the key, but skip the last one.
Tap the coin after you tap the heart.
Use orange on the star and purple on the bell.
Build a robot with claws and a purple body, not an orange one. Give it a blue nose, not a purple one.
Tap the blue sword.
Tap the coin. The small one.
Tap the big heart.
Press the blue button.
Boo the ghost went to the market. He bought a blue mushroom, and then he went home for lunch. What did Boo buy?
Tap both coins.
Tap the book, then tap the coin.
The code is two, one, zero.
If you see a dragon, tap the hat.
After you tap the star, tap the coin.
Tap the potion.
Hoot the owl found a green shield behind the castle. What did Hoot find?
Tap the sword, but only if there are more keys than hats.
Tap the star that is not orange.
Captain says, tap the mushroom, then the coin.
Tap the mushroom. After that, tap the boot.
Some of the books are yellow.
Tap the green sword, then the purple crown.
This robot has a yellow body and an orange nose.
Tap the big bell, unless it is green.
Tap the potion first, and the coin last.
Sir Clank the knight had two potions, an orange one and a red one. Boo the ghost had none. So Sir Clank gave Boo the orange one and kept the other. Which potion does Boo have now?
If you see a ghost, tap the map. If not, tap the star.
First, tap the blue knight. Then, the yellow book. Last, the purple torch.
Tap the big shield, unless it is yellow.
Tap the yellow torch, then the yellow drum.
After you tap the egg, tap the hat.
Go to the house, then the pond, then the tent, then the rock.
Put the purple star and the blue gem in the chest and the bell in the cart, but only if there is a sword on the shelf.
Tap the orange crown.
Paint the ring and the map yellow.
Tap the book two times, then tap the rocket.
Boo the ghost went to the market. He bought a blue boot, and then he went home for lunch. What did Boo buy?
Tap the blue owl, then the yellow dragon, then the green egg.
Tap these backwards: the drum, the owl, the crown, and the chest.
If there are more rings than bells, put two rings in the bag. If not, put two bells in the cart.

Pounce the cat was getting ready for the big parade. First, she banged the drum. Then she rang the bell. After that, she cleaned the muddy boot. Last of all, she painted the shield. Then the parade began. Tap the four things in the order they happened.
Tap everything except the star.
Go left three squares.
The green egg is in the middle of the row.
Captain says, tap the blue egg.
Paint the big egg and the big ring purple.
If there is a gem, tap the key. If not, tap the drum.
Tap the drum, the chest, the crown, and then the star.
There was a key, a book, and a ring on the shelf. A cat knocked the book onto the floor. What fell on the floor?
Tap the yellow coin.
Tap the purple potion, the yellow gem, and then the green dragon.
Flip the green switch, then press the orange button.
Captain says, tap the blue ring.
First, tap the coin. Then, tap the star. Last, tap the rocket.
Hoot the owl put a key under the flag and a gem under the map. Later, she moved the key under the hat. Then she moved the gem to the place where the key was at the start. Where is the key now?

Boo the ghost and Hoot the owl went to a picnic by the lake. Boo brought a red gem, and Hoot brought a blue chest. When it was time to go home, they each picked up the wrong thing by mistake. What did Boo take home?
Tap the orange coin.
Tap the one to the right of the ring.
Paint all the coins green. Paint the boot purple, but only if it is small.
Some of the hearts are big.
Paint the book orange and the hat green.
If you see a knight, tap the drum.
Set the dial to seven.
If you see an owl, tap the bell. If not, tap the flag.
Use red on the sword and green on the boot.
Go up one, left two, up two, right one, then down one.
If the torch is blue, tap it.
Tap the orange shield.
Find the blue bell and tap it.
Tap the hat three times.
First, tap the chest. Then, tap the star. Last, tap the hat.
Put the red heart in the bag after you put the drum and the gem in the pot.
Tap these in the opposite order: the fox, the cat, and the wizard.
First, tap the mushroom. Next, the star. Then, the torch. Last, the crown.
Dash the fox found a map and gave it to Hoot the owl. Hoot did not need it, so she passed it on to Boo the ghost. Boo did not want it either, so he gave it back to Hoot. Who has the map now?
Do not put two boots under the table until you have put the green drum in the bag.
Tap all the green things except the sword.
Give the robot three eyes, an orange body, two buttons and one antenna.
Tap the blue heart, the orange coin, and then the yellow ring.
Paint all the big things yellow, unless they are drums. Paint the small drum blue.
Tap the key, then the mushroom, then the drum.
Tap the big green book, then the big green shield, then the small green book, then the big red book.
Tap the small heart, unless it is purple.
Tap the coin, then the dragon, then the torch, then the book, then the ghost, then the potion.
First put the coin in the basket, then the red egg in the pot, and last the rocket in the basket.
Tap the red bell.
Press the yellow button two times, then flip the red switch.
Use the blue paint on the mushroom.
If there are fewer hats than keys, tap the gem. If not, tap the sword.
Tap the yellow hat.
Tap the flag, then tap the star two times.
Tap all the rockets, but only if there are exactly two.
Put the orange key and the blue heart in the bag and the shield on the table, but only if there is a crown on the shelf.
Paint all the rockets purple.

Zip the robot hid a coin inside the boot. A crow was watching, so he moved it under the hat. He thought about putting it behind the drum, but he did not. In the end, he put it back where it was at the start. Where is the coin now?
Tap all the orange things except the drum.
Put the red shield in the pot and the purple heart in the bag.
Tap the sword, then the potion, then the fox, then the ring, then the hat, then the robot.
Tap the coin in the bottom row.
There are three purple mushrooms.
Tap the chest. No, wait! Tap the book instead.
Drive the rover to the rock.
Tap the star, then the heart, then the shield.
Tap the big yellow torch.
It is time to wake up the whole castle. What makes a loud ringing sound?
If there is a ring, tap the map. If not, tap the egg.
If there is a book on the shelf, put it in the bag. If not, put the egg in the pot.
Go to the rock. Pick up the coin on the way, but only if it is purple.
Before you put two swords in the basket, put the yellow drum and the book in the bag.
Tap the ring, but only if you see both a wizard and an owl.
Tap the green key.
Tap the red sword.

Pounce the cat put on a magic show for the whole village. First, she bent a key in half. Then she made a coin vanish. After that, she made a ring spin in the air. Last of all, she made a star glow. What was the second thing Pounce did?
Sir Clank the knight found a blue hat on the beach. Boo the ghost found a green shield. Then they swapped, just for fun. What does Boo have now?
Move the rover left one square.
Go to the tent, unless there is a house next to it. If there is, go to the bridge.
Captain says, tap the blue rocket.
The code is zero, one, two, nine.
All the coins are red.

There was a big party at the castle last night. Puff the dragon was sick in bed and could not come. Zazz the wizard got lost and never got there. Sir Clank the knight arrived late and stayed to the end. Boo the ghost came early and helped with the food. Dash the fox forgot all about it and stayed home. Tap everyone who was at the party.
Build a robot with a green body and a red nose.
None of the flags are big.
Tap the star on the right.
The key is bigger than the shield.
Before you go to the pond, visit the tent.
Go right three, up two, then left three.
Tap the big blue rocket.
Press every button that is neither yellow nor red, then flip the orange switch.
Flip the yellow switch.
Tap the boot, then the shield, then the potion, then the key.
The map is yellow, but the gem is not green.
Tap the small orange boot.
Paint every shield orange, but not the big one. Paint that one green.
Tap the bell, then the coin, then the gem, then the wizard.
Put one sword in the bag and two in the pot.
Tap both hearts.
The code is one, nine, five, four.
The robot has neither claws nor short arms. The body and the nose are both yellow. Give the robot legs and three buttons.
Tap the big blue chest, then the small yellow egg, then the small yellow chest, then the small blue chest.
Tap the egg, then the ring, then the mushroom, then the map, then the fox.
Zazz the wizard picked up a torch. Then he picked up an egg. Last, he picked up a book. What did Zazz pick up last?
The dragon says, tap the green crown.
Go down one square.
The pirates have a pile of gold to hide. What should they lock it in?
Tap the small key.
Hoot packed a potion for the trip. Boo packed a bell. Then they walked to the castle together. What did Boo pack?
Tap the boot to the left of the heart.
Put three blue swords in the bag.
Hoot the owl had two chests, a yellow one and a green one. Zazz the wizard had none. So Hoot gave Zazz the yellow one and kept the other. Which chest does Hoot have now?
Before you give the robot a red nose, give it short arms. Then give it one eye, a jet and three buttons.
The body is not orange and not blue. Give the robot a jet and a round head.

At midnight, the whole castle was asleep. Pounce the cat crept down the hall to find a snack. First, she slipped past a chest very quietly. Then she tiptoed around a potion as softly as a mouse. After that, she tripped over a shield, and it rolled away with a loud bang. Soon everyone was wide awake. Which thing woke everyone up?
Dash the fox hid the ring behind the shield. Where is the ring?
Tap the sword before the torch.
If the star is green, tap it.
Use purple on the sword and blue on the book.
There are as many flags as books.
Tap the blue ring, then the green drum, then the orange star.
First, tap the sword. Then, tap the mushroom. Last, tap the torch.
Tap the fox.
Tap the small yellow star, then the small blue star, then the big yellow sword, then the small yellow sword.
The robot gets one button, unless it has claws. Then it gets three buttons. Give it a jet, a square head and short arms.
Tap the egg, then the gem, then the bell.
Tap the sword.
If the map is orange, tap it.
Tap everything except the torch.
Tap the sword that is not yellow.
Paint all the drums blue, all the flags yellow, and the boot red.
Tap the torch, the gem, the robot, the drum, the owl, and then the star.
If you see a dragon, tap the book. If not, tap the crown.
If the crown is blue and the boot is yellow, tap the crown and then the boot. If not, tap the boot and then the crown.
Dash the fox picked up a flag. Then she picked up a drum. Last, she picked up a rocket. Tap them in the same order.
Tap the boot, then the map, then the star.
If the small shield is yellow, tap the drum and then the chest. If it is not, tap the chest and then the drum.

Puff the dragon put on a magic show for the whole village. First, he bent a key in half. Next, he made a ring spin in the air. After that, he pulled a rabbit out of a hat. Finally, he made a coin vanish. What did Puff do right after he bent the key in half?
Tap the shield to the right of the drum.

Boo the ghost hid a gem under the bell. That did not feel safe enough, so he moved it inside the boot. He thought about putting it inside the rocket, but he did not. In the end, he put it back where it was at the start. Where is the gem now?
Tap the hat first, and the book last.
Set the dial to four, press the green button, press the orange button, then press launch.
If the bell is blue, tap it.
The body is not orange and not green. Give the robot long arms and an orange nose.
If there are more eggs than hearts, tap the torch and then the drum. If not, tap the drum and then the torch.
Tap the star, unless there is a cat.
Tap the egg, but only if it is red.
Tap the potion next to the bell.
Captain says, tap the red bell.
Drive three squares to the right.
Tap the book three times.
Tap everything that is green and small.
Tap the orange drum.
First, tap the sword. Then, tap the shield. Last, tap the egg.
Tap the ring next to the orange bell.
First go up one square. Then go left two squares.
If there is a hat on the shelf, put all the coins in the basket. If not, put them in the pot.
Tap the map, then tap the chest.
Tap the sword. After that, tap the potion.
Put the green flag and two drums in the basket, and the gem under the table.
Put all the flags in the cart except the yellow one. After that, put the key in the pot.
Tap the orange star, then the green book.
Pounce the cat found a green potion by the river. Puff the dragon found a red torch. Then they swapped, just for fun. What does Puff have now?
Go to the rock. Do not touch the house.
Put the gem in the cart.
Tap the boot. Then tap the key.
Tap the fourth one from the right.
Type this code backwards: two, five, four, one. Then press launch.
Paint the heart orange and the big crown green.
Give the robot a purple body, the most eyes, the fewest antennas and a yellow nose.
Tap the red drum, then the purple star, then the orange potion.
Tap the torch. After that, tap the sword.
Zazz the wizard found a hat and gave it to Pounce the cat. Pounce did not need it, so she passed it on to Hoot the owl. Hoot kept it safe. Who has the hat now?
Boo the ghost had a blue chest and an orange flag. He gave the chest to a friend. What does Boo have now?
Tap the flag, and then the ring.
Give the robot long arms, a yellow nose and a square head.
Put all the torches on the table, unless there is a mushroom on the shelf.
Tap the coin, but only if it is yellow.
Flip the green switch, then press the purple button two times.
Tap the green mushroom.
Tap the dragon, the knight, the coin, the boot, and the flag, but skip the third one.
Tap the purple torch, then the green key.
Put the big boot in the bag and the small boot on the table.
Tap the third purple one from the left.
Paint the first bell from the left yellow, the first bell from the right blue, and the ring red.

Dash the fox set up camp in the forest at sunset. She checked the map. But before she did that, she put up the flag. After those two things, she lit the torch. Last of all, she played the drum. Tap the four things in the order they really happened.
Put the boot in the pot.
Tap the drum to the left of the book.
Tap the blue cat, then the purple torch, then the red key.
Tap the hat that is not green.
The robot has neither legs nor wheels. Give the robot three antennas, four buttons, a red body and a pointy head.
Put two boots and the sword under the table.
There are three maps.
Flip the red switch.
Tap the flag, then the bell, then the boot. After that, tap the gem, then the shield, then the owl.
After you put all the crowns under the table, put the potion on the table.
First, tap the bell. Then, tap the potion. Last, tap the hat.
If there are more maps than hats, paint the maps green. If not, paint the hats purple.
Tap the owl, the robot, the cat, and then the potion.
The code is one, seven, three.
Somebody took the pie from the kitchen window. There were feathers on the floor. The thief had flown away over the wall without a sound, long after dark. Who took the pie?
Tap these in the opposite order: the torch, the egg, the rocket, and the wizard.
Tap the chest, but only if it is green.
The second thing from the left is a shield.
If you see a dragon, tap the potion.
Set the dial to one.
Make the bell orange.

At midnight, the whole castle was asleep. Pounce the cat crept down the hall to find a snack. First, she stepped over a sword without a sound. Then she bumped into a rocket, and it fell over with a loud crash. After that, she tiptoed around an egg as softly as a mouse. Soon everyone was wide awake. Which thing woke everyone up?
Tap the egg. After that, tap the book.
Go to the tower, then to the house.
Press the green button, then type the code nine, six, zero.
Go to the tent, then to the tree.
Zip the robot put a key behind the book and an egg inside the chest. Later, he moved the key under the crown. Then he moved the egg to the place where the key was at the start. Where is the key now?
Go to the bridge. On the way, pick up only the gem.
Tap the flag. Then tap the heart.
Tap all the yellow things except the torch.
The code is seven, three, six.
Tap the sword, then the key, then the map. After that, tap the bell, then the book.
Boo the ghost picked up a shield. Then he picked up a star. Last, he picked up a gem. What did Boo pick up right before the gem?
Tap the potion that is not purple.
First, tap the rocket. Next, the shield. Then, the egg. Last, the chest.
Paint all the chests purple except the big one.
Go right two, down one, then left one.
Tap the red flag, then the orange drum, then the orange chest.
Dash the fox picked up a torch. Then she picked up a potion. Last, she picked up a heart. What did Dash pick up right after the torch?
First, tap the shield. Next, the boot. Then, the key. Last, the rocket.

Hoot the owl put on a magic show for the whole village. First, she made a book fly. Then she made a potion bubble. At the very end, she pulled a rabbit out of a hat. But just before the end, she bent a key in half. Tap the four things in the order they really happened.
First, tap the mushroom. Then, tap the coin. Last, tap the chest.
Put everything that is neither blue nor purple in the bag.
Tap the big flag.
Tap the hat that is not next to a map.
Tap the mushroom, then the ring, then the boot.
Tap the one to the right of the potion.
Tap these backwards: the sword, the map, the star, and the egg.
Tap the egg, then the drum, then the flag.
Go to the rock, then to the tree, then to the cave.
After you put all the rings in the pot, put the bell under the table.

Sir Clank the knight put on a magic show for the whole village. First, he pulled a rabbit out of a hat. Next, he bent a key in half. After that, he made a book fly. Finally, he made a ring spin in the air. What did Sir Clank do right before he made the ring spin in the air?
Tap the orange crown, then the orange sword, then the yellow rocket.
Tap the heart, and then the key.
After you tap the key, tap the egg.
If you see a ghost, tap the drum. If not, tap the egg.
Before tapping the egg, tap the gem.
Paint all the hats purple, all the crowns blue, and the mushroom red.
The wizard is lost in the forest. What should he look at to find his way?
Go to the house after you visit the rock, and do not touch the tent.
Tap the crown before the rocket.

Sir Clank the knight put a ring under the hat and a star behind the book. Later, he moved the ring behind the shield. Then he moved the star to the place where the ring was at the start. Where is the star now?
Tap the flag, then the coin, then the egg.
Tap everything you can read.
Tap the ring, then the star.
Visit every place except the bridge, and finish at the tower.
Find the green hat and tap it.
Give the robot a yellow nose, three eyes and wheels. It has more buttons than eyes.
Tap the potion, then the boot, then the crown. After that, tap the owl, then the egg.
Tap the flag before you tap the map.
The prince wants to give the princess something small and shiny to wear on her finger. What is it?
Tap the rocket. The big one.
Tap all the green mushrooms.

Sir Clank the knight had a very silly dream. In the dream, a boot was chasing a drum around the castle. A potion was singing a song, and a star was dancing on the table. Then he woke up. Which one of these was not in the dream?
Tap the sword that is not green.
Paint the map purple.
Paint the rocket green and the star purple.
Set the dial to six.
There are three mushrooms.
There are four chests.

Snowballs were flying across the castle yard. Sir Clank the knight did not want a cold, wet face. He picked up something big, flat and strong, and held it in front of him. Every snowball went splat against it. What was Sir Clank holding?
Tap the blue gem.
The code is five, zero, seven, eight, four.
Tap the hat, and then the gem.
Some of the eggs are small.
There are more eggs than rings.
Tap the key, then the flag, then the mushroom.

At midnight, the whole castle was asleep. Boo the ghost crept down the hall to find a snack. First, he tripped over a book, and it rolled away with a loud bang. Then he slipped past a chest very quietly. After that, he tiptoed around a flag as softly as a mouse. Soon everyone was wide awake. Which thing woke everyone up?
Go up two squares.

Sir Clank the knight tidied up the playroom. He put a potion on the shelf and a key in the toy box. Under the bed, he found a chest and a sword, both covered in dust. Then he lay down for a nap. Which one of these was not in the story?
Tap the one between the torch and the chest.
The code is eight, nine, one, five.
None of the mushrooms are blue.
Count the eggs. Tap the potion that many times.
There are three yellow boots.
It is a sunny day at camp. Now, tap the purple egg.
Put the red map on the table and the blue map in the cart.
Put three orange hats in the pot.
Tap the red drum.
Tap the egg two times.

Hoot the owl packed a bag for a trip to the beach. She put in a gem, a map, a flag, and a key. Then she changed her mind. She took out the map and the key. Just before she left, she added a sword. Tap everything that is in the bag now.
Zip the robot had two maps, a purple one and a blue one. Boo the ghost had none. So Zip gave Boo the purple one and kept the other. Which map does Zip have now?
Tap the egg before the shield.
Go to the tower, then the rock, then the bridge, then the tent.
Tap the small hat.
Tap these backwards: the hat, the potion, the mushroom, and the key.
If you see an owl, tap the flag. If not, tap the key.
The potion is orange.
Set the dial to zero, flip the red switch, then press the red button. If the light is red, flip the purple switch. If it is green, press launch instead.
Tap the big orange flag.
Tap the yellow crown, the orange fox, and then the red chest.
Go to the tree. Pick up the star on the way, but only if it is orange.
Tap everything that is blue.
First put three rockets in the cart, then the green potion in the bag, and last the drum in the cart.
Give the robot two eyes, a jet, three buttons and no antennas.
Before you give the robot four eyes, give it wheels. Then give it long arms, a green body and two buttons.
Flip the green switch.
The bell is next to the chest.
Make the crown blue.
Tap the mushroom. After that, tap the bell.
Tap the torch, and then the hat.
Put all the maps in the pot and all the stars in the bag.
If there is a gem, tap the torch. If not, tap the hat.
Tap these in the opposite order: the bell and the book.
Tap the things you can wear that are red.
The potion is big.
If there are fewer torches than flags, tap the mushroom. If not, tap the boot.
Go to the cave after you visit the rock, and do not touch the house.
Tap the coin before you tap the gem.
Tap the small orange crown.
Tap the yellow map.
The robot gets three eyes, unless it has a jet. Then it gets one eye. Give it a blue body, long arms and a jet.
Zip the robot found an orange flag on the hill. Dash the fox found a blue bell. Each of them wanted what the other one had, so they traded. What does Dash have now?
If the small ring is blue, tap the hat and then the potion. If it is not, tap the potion and then the hat.
Put the orange flag and the red rocket in the cart.
Tap the rocket, then tap the boot two times.
Flip the red switch, then type the code four, eight, two.
Before tapping the boot, tap the star.
The knight gave a shield to the fox. Who gave the shield away?
Give the robot short arms, not long arms. It also needs legs, not wheels, and a blue body.
Tap the mushroom, and then the heart.
Tap the green crown, then the orange egg.
Flip the orange switch, then type the code five, eight, four.
Tap the big red coin.
Tap everything except the heart.
Tap the potion, then the flag, then the egg, then the star.

Zip the robot wanted to visit the moon. Walking was no good, and even his friends with wings could not fly that high. So Zip built something tall with fire coming out of the bottom, climbed inside, and counted down from ten. What did Zip build?
Use the red paint on the mushroom.
Tap the first owl from the right.
Dash the fox was carrying a rocket up the hill. Hoot the owl was carrying a crown. Puff the dragon waved at them from the top. Halfway up, Dash and Hoot swapped. Who is carrying the crown now?

Hoot the owl spent the morning at the village market. To start with, she tapped on a drum. Next, she flipped through a book. Then she looked at a map. At the very end, she sniffed a potion. Then she walked home for lunch. Tap the four things in the order they happened.
Tap the yellow rocket.

Boo the ghost spent the morning at the village market. First, he bought an egg. Next, he tapped on a drum. After that, he sniffed a potion. Finally, he tried on a hat. What did Boo do right after he sniffed the potion?
If there are as many swords as rings, tap the hat. If not, tap the bell.
First put two torches on the table, then the green mushroom in the basket, and last the book on the table.
Pounce the cat had a green key and a blue hat. She gave the key to a friend. What does Pounce have now?
Paint the potion red and the small chest blue.
Tap the rocket that is not blue.
There was a potion, a flag, and a torch on the shelf. A cat knocked the potion onto the floor. What fell on the floor?
Press the blue button two times, then type the code five, two, nine, then press launch.
Tap everything that is yellow.
Go to the cave.
Tap all the yellow mushrooms.
Tap the fourth orange one from the right.
Tap the rocket after the book.
If the hat is green, tap it.
Tap the map, then the potion, then the coin, then the bell.
Tap all the stars.
Tap the yellow coin, then the yellow star, then the orange potion.
Tap the map.
This robot has a blue body, a round head and long arms.
Tap all the animals.
Tap the ring that is not purple.
Give the robot a square head, one eye, three buttons and short arms.
Tap the book. No, wait! Tap the rocket instead.
Go left three, up one, left one, then down one.
Tap the flag, then the book, then the key, then the torch.
The code is seven, five, two.
Tap the small blue sword.
Captain says, tap the red heart.
Build a robot with a jet and short arms.

Puff the dragon spent the morning at the village market. First, he bought a mushroom. Next, he waved a flag. After that, he tried on a hat. Finally, he tapped on a drum. What did Puff do right before he waved the flag?
Set the dial to three, then press the red button.
If the robot has legs, it gets two eyes. If it has wheels, it gets three eyes. Give it a purple body, legs and a round head.

Zip the robot had a birthday party. Dash the fox gave him an egg, and he said a quiet thank you. Boo the ghost gave him a sword, and he jumped for joy. Pounce the cat gave him a crown, and he just yawned. Which present did Zip like best?
Sir Clank the knight picked up a sword. Then he picked up a boot. Last, he picked up a drum. What did Sir Clank pick up last?
Tap the heart. The yellow one.
There is a blue crown and no purple map.
Tap the one to the left of the chest.
Paint the second rocket from the left blue, the first rocket from the right green, and the mushroom yellow.
First, tap the crown. Then, tap the sword.
Tap the potion three times.
Tap the crown in the top row.
Put everything red in the bag.
Tap these backwards: the egg, the heart, and the shield.
The robot has neither short arms nor claws. The body and the nose are both orange. Give the robot no antennas and a pointy head.
This robot has a yellow body and a blue nose.
Tap the key, then tap the flag.
Before you put the boot in the cart, put three mushrooms on the table.
All the rings are small, and there are three green things.
If the key is purple, tap it.
The king wants to show how much he loves his people. Which shape means love?
Tap the boot after the bell.
Tap the rocket before you tap the sword.
If you see a ghost, tap the torch.
Boo the ghost is carrying a key to the castle. What is Boo carrying?
Before you tap the egg, tap the star.

Pounce the cat and Zazz the wizard went to a picnic by the lake. Pounce brought a purple hat, and Zazz brought a green torch. When it was time to go home, they each picked up the wrong thing by mistake. What did Pounce take home?
Tap the rocket that is between the two rings.
Paint the one in the middle orange, the last two red, and the first two yellow.
Tap the ring, the heart, the map, the crown, the egg, and then the bell.
Tap these in the opposite order: the mushroom, the rocket, and the book.
Put two keys and the boot under the table.
Do not give the robot legs or wheels. Give it a pointy head and an orange body.
Tap the orange sword.
Give the robot short arms, a green body and legs.
Use green on the sword and yellow on the hat.
Blip polished his antenna today. Now, tap the blue mushroom.
Put three books and one hat in the bag.
First, tap the big purple coin. Next, the big purple ring. Then, the small purple coin. Last, the small purple ring.
Tap the things that are neither yellow nor big.
Paint all the rings yellow. Paint the egg orange, but only if it is big.
Go to the house.
First, tap the sword. Then, tap the shield. Last, tap the key.
Put the blue coin under the table and the green coin in the pot.
First, tap the hat. Then, tap the bell. Last, tap the gem.
There is a small ring.
All the mushrooms are small.
Hoot the owl picked up a book. Then she picked up a shield. Last, she picked up a star. What did Hoot pick up first?
Tap these in the opposite order: the ring, the boot, and the owl.
Tap the red rocket, then the red torch.

Boo the ghost tidied up the playroom. He put a gem on the shelf and a mushroom in the toy box. Under the bed, he found a bell and a boot, both covered in dust. Then he lay down for a nap. Which one of these was not in the story?
Paint every potion orange, but not the small one. Paint that one red.
Tap the ring, then the hat, then the boot.
Tap the flag, and then the boot.
Tap all the bells.
Build a robot with a jet, long arms and a yellow body.
Tap the torch, then the boot, then the star.

Dash the fox walked into a cave. It was so dark that she could not see her own paws. Then a friend handed her a stick with a flame on top, and at last she could see the way. What did the friend give Dash?
Paint everything red except the key.
The team won the race, and they want to wave something high in the air. What should they wave?

Sir Clank the knight hid a ring under the map. That did not feel safe enough, so he moved it behind the shield. Somebody walked by, so he moved it one more time, inside the rocket. Where was the ring before the very last move?
Go left two, down two, right one, up one, then right two.
Paint both things next to the ring yellow, the ring blue, and the last one purple.

Zip the robot was getting ready for the big parade. To start with, he waved the flag. Next, he put on the crown. Then he polished the sword. At the very end, he painted the shield. What did Zip do after he put on the crown but before he painted the shield?
Tap the orange heart.
Tap the third red one from the right.
Tap the small star.
Tap everything you can make music with.
Tap the crown that is not purple.
Tap the one between the star and the map.
Tap the sword first, and the map last.
Tap the coin two times, then tap the ring.
Go to the house, then the cave, then the tower, then the tree.
Before you tap the shield, tap the hat.
First, tap the big green drum. Next, the small purple mushroom. Then, the small purple drum. Last, the small green mushroom.
This robot has a round head, a blue nose and claws.
Captain says, tap the orange book.
Go down one, right three, then up one.
Tap all the red drums.
Tap all the keys, but only if there are exactly four.
Put the green boot and the yellow bell in the chest.
Give the robot a square head and wheels.
There was a heart, a crown, and a star on the shelf. A cat knocked the crown onto the floor. What fell on the floor?
Do not put three coins in the bag until you have put the yellow mushroom under the table.
Put the flag in the chest.
Tap the animals that are blue.
Zip the robot hid a gem inside the boot. A crow was watching, so he moved it behind the shield. A mouse came sniffing around, so he moved it one more time, under the flag. Where is the gem now?
Give the robot a red nose, a green body and one antenna. It has the same number of eyes as antennas.
Tap the purple shield.
Tap the rocket, the map, the torch, and then the key.
Zip the robot is carrying a shield to the castle. What is Zip carrying?
Tap the shield on the left.
Go to the green flag.

Hoot the owl sat on her nest all week to keep something warm. It was smooth and round, and she had to be very gentle with it. On Sunday it cracked open, and a tiny beak poked out. What was Hoot sitting on?
Set the dial to five and flip the orange switch.
Put three bells in the bag and three hats in the cart.
Paint the small star orange and the big star green.
Paint the star yellow and the big ring orange.
A miner was digging and found something sparkly inside a rock. What was it?
After you tap the ring, tap the torch.
Tap the gem. The purple one.
Paint the small gem and the big shield green.
Tap the knight.
Build a robot with one button, short arms, a yellow nose and two eyes.
Press the yellow button.
Before you put the drum in the chest, put three potions under the table.
Boo the ghost went to the market. He bought a purple drum, and then he went home for lunch. What did Boo buy?

Pounce the cat had three friends to visit. She planned to see Sir Clank the knight first, then Boo the ghost, and Zazz the wizard last. But Boo was fast asleep, so Pounce skipped him and saw the other two. Tap the friends in the order Pounce really saw them.
Find the map and put it in the basket.

Hoot the owl hid a ring under the bell. A crow was watching, so she moved it under the flag. She thought about putting it behind the drum, but she did not. In the end, she left it right where it was. Where is the ring now?
Tap the hat on the left.
Before tapping the bell, tap the flag.

Tap the heart, the flag, the boot, and then the egg.

The milk jug was empty. There were small, muddy paw prints across the kitchen table. Under a chair, someone was licking her whiskers and purring. Who drank the milk?

Paint the small key purple and the big key yellow.
Tap the star three times.

Tap the potion. Oh, and tap the map too.

Give the robot a blue nose, the shorter legs, the longest arms and one antenna.

First, tap the map. Then, tap the book. Last, tap the torch.

Boo the ghost found a potion and gave it to Zazz the wizard. Zazz did not need it, so he passed it on to Pounce the cat. Pounce took it back to the one who found it. Who has the potion now?

Puff the dragon packed a bag for a long boat ride. He put in a drum, a map, and a red heart. Then he changed his mind. He took out the red heart and put in a purple heart instead. Just before he left, he added a potion. Tap everything that is in the bag now.
Tap the robot, the chest, the coin, the ghost, and then the boot.
Tap the blue shield.

Paint everything that is neither an egg nor a boot orange. Paint the eggs red.
Paint the third ring from the left purple, the third ring from the right blue, and the shield yellow.

Zazz the wizard hid a star under the bell. A mouse came sniffing around, so he moved it under the hat. Then it started to rain, so he moved it one more time, under the flag. Where is the star now?

Tap the red owl, the yellow gem, and then the blue egg.
Tap the yellow boot, the blue flag, and then the red dragon.

Sir Clank the knight was getting ready for the big parade. To start with, he painted the shield. Next, he brushed the hat. Then he cleaned the muddy boot. At the very end, he rang the bell. What did Sir Clank do right before he brushed the hat?
First, tap the drum. Next, the key. Then, the rocket. Last, the boot.
Tap the boot next to the mushroom.
Tap the third one from the left.

Sir Clank the knight had a birthday party. Pounce the cat gave him a mushroom, and he put it away in a drawer. Zip the robot gave him a crown, and he laughed out loud. Zazz the wizard gave him a boot, and he said a quiet thank you. Which present did Sir Clank like best?

Dash the fox set off for the snowy hills with a potion, a sword, a boot, and a flag. On the way, the boot fell down a deep well, and nobody could reach it. Later, the wind blew the flag away, but she found it in a bush. In the end, Dash had to turn back. Why did Dash have to turn back?

There was a big party at the castle last night. Dash the fox wanted to come, but she had to work. Pounce the cat arrived late and stayed to the end. There was a big party at the castle last night. Zazz the wizard wanted to come, but he had to work. Pounce the cat came early and helped with the food. At midnight, the whole castle was asleep. Boo the ghost crept down the hall to find a snack. First, he bumped into a potion, and it fell over with a loud crash. Boo the ghost set off for the snowy hills with a potion, an egg, a coin, and a flag. On the way, he dropped the potion in a puddle, but he fished it out. Later, he left the egg on a rock and never found it again. In the end, Boo had to turn back. Why did Boo have to turn back?
